title: Munich Motor Imagery dataset
description: The Munich Motor Imagery dataset comprises EEG recordings from 10 healthy subjects performing two-class motor imagery tasks (left and right hand) cued by visual arrow stimuli. Recorded at 500 Hz using 128 channels with a standard 10-20 montage, the dataset includes 150 trials per subject and has been preprocessed with common average re-referencing. This dataset is widely used for benchmarking brain-computer interface algorithms including common spatial patterns, beamforming, and other spatial filtering techniques.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 500 Hz sampling rate using 128 channels arranged in a standard 10-20 montage with reference at Cz. Subjects performed motor imagery of left or right hand movements in response to directional arrow cues presented for 7 seconds. Data were preprocessed offline with common average re-referencing (CAR) and no artifact rejection was applied. The dataset includes 150 trials total, with equal distribution across the two imagery classes.
